CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 12
   D. 14

2. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 2

3. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

4. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

6. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 121

7. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24

9. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 32

10. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

11. Solve for x: x + 5 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 5
   C. 12
   D. 7

12. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 13
   C. 3
   D. 41

13. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 18

14. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 1
   C. 73
   D. 17

15. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 18

16. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 170
   D. 169

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
